name: predict_binding_affinity
description: Predict protein-ligand binding affinity given a UniProt ID and a SMILES string
usage: from app.tools.biomni.pharmacology import predict_binding_affinity; result = predict_binding_affinity('P00533', 'CC1=CC=C(C=C1)NC2=NC=CC(=N2)NC3=CC=CC(=C3)S(=O)(=O)N')

parameters.protein_uniprot_id: str — UniProt accession of the target protein
parameters.smiles: str — SMILES string of the ligand

returns: dict with keys: protein_uniprot_id, smiles, estimated_kd_nm, estimated_ki_nm, note
